# spyro pins

List all pinned sync directories.

## Before you run it

Lists pinned directories. Read-only.

Read `spyro profiles` first for hosts and `remote_path`; the `spyro` skill has the safety rules.

## Reference (from `--help`)

### `spyro pins`

```text
Usage: spyro pins [OPTIONS]

  List all pinned sync directories.

Options:
  --json  Output as JSON
  --help  Show this message and exit.
```
